_note: Golden comparison against the SMM pack's overlays «Оверлей_9x16» (1080x1920) and «Оверлей_1x1» (1440x1440, scaled to 1080). At rest (0 s) the frame is the pack's; the steps' drift is on M10 (D19): the master passes the pack's turning points 15 s apart, so the master at 15 s is the pack at 4 s (9:16; the 1:1 turning points fall between the golden's key times). Green and white are the dark frame with its colour remapped. 16:9 turns the 9:16 frame a quarter: no pack frame shows it, it is approved by eye (README).
